content:
It's been a few years, but it's time to Lean Together again!

In January 2021, 2020 and 2019 we had Lean user meetings. @David Thrane Christiansen , @Patrick Massot , and I are planning an online Lean Together 2024, January 9-12. The times and format are TBD, but mark those dates on your calendars. We'll try to schedule things starting at different times on different days, to account for various timezones. We expect to devote time to formalized math, to Lean as a programming language, to UI features, and beyond.

We'll reach out to some of you directly about giving talks, but we'd also like to solicit contributed talks from the community. Anything Lean- or formalization-related is in scope. A big point of these workshops is to get an idea of what other people around the world are working on and to coordinate efforts. We're not only looking for polished conference talks, and we'd like to leave plenty of time for discussion. Students, faculty, professional programmers, hobbyists: all are welcome. The Lean community has grown massively since the last Lean Together - while we hope to have time for all proposals, we will be attempting to have a balanced, interesting, and diverse program rather than to rank each proposal in a fixed order.

Would you/your team/your research group possibly be interested in presenting something that week? Please propose something here: here is a Google form, and you'll be able to edit the details of your talk as the date approaches. The earlier you submit, the better. We hope to put together a full program by mid-December. Again, we hope for a mix of casual and more formal presentations, expecting more of the former. And we're happy to answer questions here.

Lean Together 2024 website
A reminder: if you are interested in speaking at Lean Together 2024 (January 9-12), please propose a talk here!

There is now a tentative schedule for Lean Together! This is still incomplete and subject to change, but since we're less than a month away with holidays in between, we wanted to put the draft out now.

A reminder that Lean Together is next week! See the schedule on our website. The start time shifts day to day, to try to accommodate different time zones as best we can. We'll have a Gather instance running throughout the event for social time -- you can wander around and chat with people during the coffee breaks or after the daily sessions.

There's a registration link on the website, but it will just be used to email you Zoom and Gather links. I'll post them here as well.
Lean Together 2024 will start tomorrow. If you are interested then please subscribe to the Lean together 2024 stream for specific information and discussion.
